from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,datetime,re
import pandas as pd
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
base=Path.cwd();out=base/'reports/research/510300_extreme_leaf_policy_information_clock_v1'
protocol=json.loads((out/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert not (out/'result.json').exists()
for p in protocol['source_receipts']:assert hashlib.sha256((base/p['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==p['sha256']
old=base/'reports/research/510300_policy_information_clock_v1'
keys=['joint_20240924_csrc','rate_20240927_govwechat']
receipts=[];texts={}
for key in keys:
    rp=old/'receipts'/f'{key}.json';r=json.loads(rp.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'));raw=old/r['raw_path']
    assert raw.stat().st_size==r['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
    body=raw.read_bytes()
    try:html=body.decode('utf-8')
    except UnicodeDecodeError:html=body.decode('gb18030')
    soup=BeautifulSoup(html,'html.parser')
    for node in soup(['script','style']):node.decompose()
    texts[key]=re.sub(r'\s+','',soup.get_text('',strip=True))
    receipts.append({'key':key,'original_receipt':r,'reused_receipt_path':str(rp.relative_to(base)).replace('\\','/'),'receipt_sha256':hashlib.sha256(rp.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'raw_path':str(raw.relative_to(base)).replace('\\','/'),'raw_sha256':r['sha256'],'same_object_reGET':False})
def save(name,obj):(out/name).write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
save('两件旧原公开全文_复用收件绑定.json',receipts)
text=texts['joint_20240924_csrc']
marks=list(re.finditer(r'2024-09-24\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2}',text))
segments=[];start=0;prev=None
for k,m in enumerate(marks):
    segments.append({'segment_id':k,'previous_marker':prev,'following_marker':m.group(0),'start_offset':start,'end_offset':m.start(),'content':text[start:m.start()]})
    start=m.end();prev=m.group(0)
save('全部36实录分段_原标记与原文.json',segments)
assert len(segments)==36
items=[
('P01','降准总量与长期流动性','准备金率计划','近期将下调存款准备金率0.5个百分点','0.5个百分点','计划、非当时已投放'),
('P02','短期政策利率','7天逆回购计划','从目前的1.7%调降至1.5%','1.7%→1.5%','计划利率，9/27才实施'),
('P03','住房现金流/信用','存量按揭调整','预计平均降幅大约在0.5个百分点左右','约0.5个百分点','预计降幅，不是每笔合同实际降幅'),
('P04','住房信用约束','二套最低首付','由当前的25%下调到15%','25%→15%','全国最低政策门槛，不是实际全部融资比例'),
('P05','住房银行融资激励','旧再贷款支持比例','由原来的60%提高到100%','60%→100%','旧3000亿元工具的支持比例，不是另新增3000亿元'),
('P06','机构资产流动性/股票融资','创设互换便利','第一项是创设证券、基金、保险公司互换便利',None,'方向性宣布、未给额度'),
('P07','公司和股东融资/股票需求','创设回购增持再贷款','第二项是创设股票回购、增持专项再贷款',None,'方向性宣布、非实际买入'),
('P08','机构资产流动性/股票融资','互换便利计划额度','互换便利首期操作规模是5000亿元','5000亿元','计划额度、不是9/24股票流入'),
('P09','公司和股东融资/股票需求','回购增持再贷款计划额度','首期额度是3000亿元','3000亿元','计划额度、不是9/24实际资金使用'),
('P10','公司和股东融资/股票需求','再贷款资金成本与支持','资金支持比例是100%，再贷款利率是1.75%','100%、1.75%','再贷款设计、不是ETF可融资利率')
]
decision=pd.Timestamp(protocol['fixed_decision_cutoff']);entry=pd.Timestamp(protocol['fixed_entry_open'])
facts=[]
for identifier,channel,field,needle,value,limit in items:
    found=[s for s in segments if needle in s['content']]
    assert len(found)==1,(identifier,len(found))
    s=found[0];m=s['following_marker'];upper=pd.Timestamp(m[:10]+'T'+m[10:]+'+08:00')
    lower=s['previous_marker']
    offset=s['content'].index(needle)
    row={'fact_id':identifier,'channel':channel,'field':field,'value_display':value,'original_text_needle':needle,'raw_segment_id':s['segment_id'],'speech_segment_previous_marker':lower,'speech_segment_end_marker':m,'speech_segment_end_proxy':upper.isoformat(),'precise_word_utterance_time':'UNKNOWN','webpage_first_publish_intraday':'UNKNOWN','webpage_date':'2024-09-24','historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'speech_after_original_decision':bool(upper>decision),'content_explicit_in_original_model_X':False,'segment_upper_before_entry_open':bool(upper<entry),'same_page_day_end_before_entry_open':False,'entry_open_known_under_live_transcript_proxy':'YES' if upper<entry else 'NO_THIS_SEGMENT_END_IS_AFTER_OPEN','entry_open_known_under_strict_webpage_timestamp':'UNKNOWN_INTRADAY_NOT_AUTHENTICATED','source_url':receipts[0]['original_receipt']['url'],'source_raw_sha256':receipts[0]['raw_sha256'],'scope_limit':limit,'precise_market_consensus':'UNKNOWN','precise_surprise':'UNKNOWN','causal_return_contribution':'UNKNOWN','raw_fragment':s['content'][max(0,offset-90):offset+len(needle)+100]}
    facts.append(row)
assert all(r['speech_after_original_decision'] for r in facts)
assert sum(r['segment_upper_before_entry_open'] for r in facts)==7
save('十项原政策信息_现场段钟与网页钟分开.json',facts)
pd.DataFrame(facts).to_csv(out/'十项原政策信息_现场段钟与网页钟分开.csv',index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
rate=texts['rate_20240927_govwechat']
assert '从9月27日起' in rate and '1.70%调整为1.50%' in rate
save('宣布与实施_同已知目标不重复计新消息.json',{'announced_target':{'date':'2024-09-24','segment_end_proxy':'2024-09-24T09:19:36+08:00','value_before':'1.7%','target':'1.5%'},'implementation':{'effective_date':'2024-09-27','webpage_date':'2024-09-27','webpage_intraday':'UNKNOWN','raw_text':rate,'source_url':receipts[1]['original_receipt']['url'],'source_raw_sha256':receipts[1]['raw_sha256']},'limitation':'9/27兑现1.5%不是第二个20bp新意外。原E44_037资金水平/当时政策率与新计划/后续实施分别保存；不认证完整预期。'})
source=base/'reports/research/510300_electricity_composition_event_source_contract_v1/全部52原根公告_同原构成与原八状态_无收益标签.parquet'
cols=['event_id','state_idx','state_date','decision_at','entry_date','exit_date','funding_available_at','orders_available_at','资金利率与政策利率差','source_url','stat_period_end']

assert current.decision_at==decision and current.entry_date==entry.tz_localize(None).normalize()
assert current.funding_available_at<=decision and current.orders_available_at<=decision
snapshot={k:(v.isoformat() if isinstance(v,pd.Timestamp) else int(v) if hasattr(v,'dtype') and 'int' in str(v.dtype) else v) for k,v in current.to_dict().items()}
snapshot.update({'price_return_columns_read':[],'new_policy_fields_in_saved_eight_features':False,'parent_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})

prior_files=[base/'research/build_policy_chain_v1.py',base/'research/policy_information_clock_v1.py',base/'research/historical_equity_funding_realization_v1.py',old/'protocol.json',old/'inputs/policy_nodes.json',base/'reports/research/510300_historical_equity_funding_realization_v1/protocol.json',base/'reports/research/510300_sfisf_prior_use_review_v1/result.json']
prior={'scope':'已读原源码/协议及政策源节点；不重跑旧政策或融资工具收益检验。','fixed_evidence':[{'path':str(p.relative_to(base)).replace('\\','/'),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in prior_files],'existing_use':'旧原节点R01/H02/C01及股票融资工具十披露节点已经含9/24宣布、10/18细则、10/21操作等；E25已拒绝把相同SFISF阶段再包装新因子。E47新增仅绑定E45成熟标签原决定/入场时钟，不新增政策Alpha。','no_prior_failure_reopened':True}
